name: Avinas
summary: Lithuanian four-player partnership trick-taking game related to Schafkopf with Rams and Pips scoring.
rules_text: Avinas is for 4 players in 2 fixed partnerships with a 32-card deck. Cards rank: in trumps QC, 7, QS,QH,QD,JC,JS,JH,JD,A,10,K,9,8; otherwise A,10,K,9,8,7. Values A=11,10=10,K=4,Q=3,J=2 total 120. Dealer deals 4 cards each, exposing 4th and 8th of opponents, and exposes any sevens from dealer side. If sevens appear, last-exposed seven's suit is trumps and its holder is declarer. If none, clockwise auction of promised trump length, longest bidder is declarer or redeal. Declarer leads a trump first. Second trick winner must lead trump if possible, otherwise may lead face-down with a private facial signal to partner about its value, others must follow as if trump, then it is revealed. Remaining tricks are whist-style must follow. With sevens, side needs >=61 points to win; declarer side may knock to commit to win all tricks, defenders may re-knock to double. Without sevens, declarer side may stop early. Scoring uses Rams and Pips with cancellation rules. Match ends when a side reaches 12 Pips, then Rams decide winner.
